{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for any non-standard formatting
print("Unique revenue values (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)
print(f"Number of QA orders: {num_qa_orders}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
num_refunded = len(refunded_orders)
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}")

# Filter out QA and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the final result
print("Total revenue by channel:")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the highest revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {max_channel} ({max_revenue:.2f})")"}
